title: Refunds (Billing Help)
text: Northwind Cloud refunds: you may request a full refund within 14 days of the initial charge. After 14 days, charges are non-refundable except where required by law. Submit refund requests from Billing > Invoices.

title: Refunds (Legal / Terms snippet)
text: Customers may cancel and receive a refund of prepaid subscription fees within 30 days of purchase. The 30-day refund window applies to monthly and annual plans purchased on the website.

title: What happens to my data after I cancel?
text: After account cancellation we delete workspace data within 30 days. Backups aging out of the 30-day window are also destroyed. Export your data before you cancel.

title: Security whitepaper: data lifecycle
text: Cancelled tenant data is retained for 90 days to support incident investigation, then purged. Security retains audit logs for 90 days after cancel.

title: Create a strong password
text: Passwords must be at least 8 characters. We recommend a passphrase. Special characters are optional.

title: Admin console: password policy
text: Organization password policy is enforced at login: minimum 12 characters, at least one number, and at least one symbol. Passwords shorter than 12 characters are rejected.

title: Getting started: two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor authentication is optional. You can enable it later from Profile > Security. You can sign in with only your password.

title: Security notice: 2FA required
text: Two-factor authentication is required for all users. Accounts without 2FA cannot sign in after 1 March 2024. Password-only sign-in is disabled.

title: Support SLA (Standard plan)
text: Standard plan support responds to Sev-2 tickets within 4 business hours, Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00 local time. This SLA does not apply to Enterprise.

title: Support SLA (Enterprise plan)
text: Enterprise plan support responds to Sev-2 tickets within 1 hour, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Standard plan customers should see the Standard SLA article.

title: API rate limits
text: The public REST API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace on paid plans and 60 requests per minute on the free plan. Burst above the cap returns HTTP 429.

title: API rate limits FAQ
text: Paid workspaces: 600 requests/minute. Free workspaces: 60 requests/minute. Repeated 429s do not increase the cap. Enterprise dedicated caps are contracted separately and are not listed here.

title: Export your workspace
text: Workspace owners can export JSON from Settings > Export. Exports include projects, comments, and attachments smaller than 50 MB. Exports do not include billing receipts.

title: Legacy refund policy (sunset)
text: This article applied only to purchases before 2019-01-01 and is retained for archives. It is not the current refund policy. Current purchases follow the Billing Help article.
